annotations.title: Assisted living supply in a state or the US

description: How much assisted living a state has: licensed facilities and capacity from the state's own list (13 states publish one with capacity), facilities with 20+ beds, memory care capacity where listed, and CDC/NCHS survey estimates (communities, beds, residents, ownership, dementia, Medicaid) beside the US figures. Omit state for US totals.

state.description: US state or DC: two-letter code (e.g. TX) or full name (e.g. "Texas"). Omit for the US.
